# Peer Review: [Project Title]

**Reviewer Name:** [Your Name]

**IMPORTANT**: As a reviewer, you will need to clone their github repo and attempt to reproduce the whole data science pipeline. Document the issues as you come across it so it can help the groups improve later on. 

## 1. Project Structure (25%)

### **Repository Organization:**  
  _Feedback on the structure of the GitHub repository and its adherence to industry standards._

- **Suggestions for improvement:**  
  _Provide specific suggestions on how to improve the repository organization._

### **Naming Conventions:**  
  _Feedback on the adoption of standard file naming conventions (snake_case) throughout the project._

- **Suggestions for improvement:**  
  _Provide specific suggestions on how to improve naming conventions._

### **README File:**  
  _Feedback on the organization and content of the README file._

- **Suggestions for improvement:**  
  _Provide specific suggestions on how to improve the README file._

---

## 2. Code Quality (25%)

### **Code Readability and Structure:**  
  _Feedback on the clarity, conciseness, and formatting of the code._

- **Suggestions for improvement:**  
  _Provide specific suggestions on how to improve code readability and structure._

### **Modularization:**  
  _Feedback on the organization of code into distinct scripts and functions._

- **Suggestions for improvement:**  
  _Provide specific suggestions on how to improve modularization._

### **Version Control:**  
  _Feedback on the use of Git version control, including commit frequency and documentation._

- **Suggestions for improvement:**  
  _Provide specific suggestions on how to improve version control practices._

---

## 3. Reproducible Environment (25%)

You will need to try to re-run the whole pipeline

### **Environment Setup:**  
  _Feedback on the clarity and thoroughness of environment setup instructions in the README._

- **Suggestions for improvement:**  
  _Provide specific suggestions on how to improve environment setup instructions._

### **Reproducibility test**

- Were you able to reproduce the pipeline? 
  - [ ] YES
  - [ ] NO
- What issues (if any) you came across when trying to reproduce their pipeline?
